# Asset Credits

This build uses Godot primitive meshes and project-authored materials for the first playable deathmatch arena, bot silhouettes, and rifle placeholders. No Valorant art, maps, audio, names, or extracted assets are included.

Approved CC0 replacement sources for later mesh/audio swaps:

- Quaternius Sci-Fi Essentials Kit: https://quaternius.com/packs/scifiessentialskit.html
  - License shown on source page: CC0
  - Intended use: modular sci-fi wall, prop, and arena dressing meshes.
- Quaternius Modular Sci-Fi Megakit: https://quaternius.com/packs/modularscifimegakit.html
  - License: verify as CC0 on the source page before importing any file.
  - Intended use: higher detail arena modules.
- Kenney assets: https://kenney.nl/assets
  - License: Kenney assets are generally CC0, but verify each selected pack before import.
  - Intended use: UI/audio placeholders if needed.

When third-party files are imported, add the exact pack name, source URL, download date, license URL, and imported file list here.
